main_body: two-story timber and stone building with tiled roof
top_band: tiled roof slope in warm orange, brown and yellow-cream tones across rows 1-42
evidence: Rows 1-42 show the foreshortened top/front roof slope with a bright ridge cap (rows 2-3), overhanging eave line at row 42, strong dark eave shadow across rows 43-47 on the plaster wall, and a full two-story front face (rows 43-106) with recessed windows and door.

style.evidence: The candidate is directly from the Beodeul chipset, sharing the exact roof tile pattern, brick chimney, speckled plaster, and stone masonry ramp as the two reference houses.
